fields.Name: Statistic
fields.Description: Root of the statistical-method space: tests and diagnostics resolved from the tree as gates on candidate models.
fields.Story: Statistics are the referees: before and after a model plays, they say whether the game was fair and the score believable.

fields.Name: Distribution Test
fields.Description: Tests on the feature/target distributions before training.
fields.Story: Checks on the raw material before anything is built from it.

fields.Name: Single-Feature Dominance
fields.Description: Flags one feature explaining suspiciously much (leakage guard input).
fields.Story: When one input already knows the answer, the model learned nothing — it copied.

fields.Name: Class Balance
fields.Description: Target class imbalance ratio and its implications for metrics.
fields.Story: A 99:1 dataset makes accuracy a lie; this test says which numbers to trust instead.

fields.Name: Fit Diagnostic
fields.Description: Post-train diagnostics on a fitted model.
fields.Story: Questions asked of the finished model, not the data.

fields.Name: Holdout Gap
fields.Story: The distance between what the model memorized and what it actually understood.
